title: Staff chat choices
decision: A table chat_pending holds what an unanswered chat question was about for 15 minutes; button data carries only identifiers and every press is authorized again; promise rows record who set them (default or staff) and the one-tap choice is open once, for 24 hours, to the author or a manager; the staff invitation link is /start s_ plus the code; a payment for a name that matches nobody who owes is refused; a question is replaced by its result instead of a second message; a pressed button is answered in the webhook response
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 19
rationale: Telegram limits button data to 64 bytes, so the typed name cannot travel in it. Replacing the message keeps within one message a second per chat. The 24-hour limit keeps REQ-008 (the seller picks after saving) apart from REQ-067 (a manager changes a date later)
